zh.explain: 自古以来温柔都胜过刚强，多施善行的人家自会非常吉祥昌盛。抽到这个签的人，会像正渴时遇到琼浆一样，心意大顺。
divination: 天地之间有感应，所以此签非常应验。得到神佛的护佑，更不能轻易忘。
items: 与人谦恭忍耐，自有贵人相助
zh.summary: 此卦积善温柔之象。所祈求之事有贵人相助则会十分和合。

verse: The gentle and kind will overcome the strong and violent.
Kind merits will be repaid with great prosperity for the family.
Your thirst will be quenched by precious wines.
interpretation: Heaven and Earth will be moved by piety.
Do not ever forget the benevolence and sympathy Heavens has shown you.
meaning: Tenderness and kindness will bring forth harmony and help from distinguished people.
en.explain: Since ancient times, gentleness has always won over force and violence. Those who do more good, are kind will naturally be very blessed and prosperous.  One who draws this lot is like encountering nectar when one is thirsty, and one’s mind will be peaceful.
divination: Heaven and Earth will be moved, so your wishes will come true. Such blessings and protection given to you by the Buddha and gods must not be easily forgotten and all the more you should be grateful to them.
items: Will be profitable in later ½ of year
Be humble and patient with others, and will have own nobles to help you
Put in your best efforts will break through difficulties
Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Should face East or West to be propitious
